intro.label: Introduction
intro.statement: I design and build fast, bilingual interfaces that feel inevitable — precise in structure, alive in movement.
intro.body: A software developer working between Cairo and the web. I care about the quiet details: a paragraph that reads well in Arabic and English, a transition that settles instead of bouncing, a page that opens before you notice it.
